title: JobPortal
description:
It solves the hussle of job seekers and recruiters by being a single async platform where the platform where gets updated with all the jobs and new hiring every hours.
Everytime for finding jobs, job seekers uses many platforms for getting a good job instead of that we compress all in one job portal where there is no need for husling for jobs on 100s of sites and having 1-1 chat with recruiters (upcoming update)
how_its_made:
Being a team of newly learning web3, blockchain we had multiple issues while interacting with blockchain which not only helped in understanding more about the stuff but also helped us in practising production level code which helped us a lot.
We faced issues in interacting with config files that's where mentors helped us in figuring out and made things easier for us to do.
